articles.summary: Scispot was built around a personal belief: life-enhancing products should not be held back by disconnected data, manual work, and slow lab operations. Learn why reducing friction in biotech R&D matters, and how connected lab data and workflows can help teams focus more time on discovery.
articles.title: Why Biotech R&D Needs Less Data Friction

articles.summary: Growing sample volume should not automatically mean more people are needed to move files, update spreadsheets, and chase approvals. Learn how connected lab workflows reduce manual coordination work so scientists can spend more time on science.
articles.title: Your Lab Is Not Scaling. It Is Hiring People to Move Files.

articles.summary: Most labs only think about audit readiness when an inspection is looming. With Scispot, compliance evidence is created and connected as work happens, so audits become a review of a clear story instead of a forensic reconstruction.
articles.title: Audit Readiness Should Be Your Daily State

articles.summary: Scispot’s MCP connector lets Claude work directly with live samples, experiments, inventory, storage, and lab workflows in your Scispot workspace. You get permission-aware AI that understands your real lab context, not just exported spreadsheets or detached files.
articles.title: Scispot MCP: Connect Your Lab to Claude
